keyword.zh: 电动20和柴油30混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 电动20和柴油30混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Electric 20 prints a 22 kW motor, 8–10 m³/h and 10 MPa. Diesel 30 prints a 4105 engine at 56 kW, 15 m³/h and 20 MPa.
description.zh: 电动20印 22 kW 电机、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa。柴油30印 4105 发动机 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa。

h1.zh: 电动20和柴油30混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 20 and Diesel 30 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 20 prints 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm and distance 120 m / 40 m. Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, aggregate 3 cm and below and distance 60 m / 180 m. The pages do not share a pipe-diameter cell.
directAnswer.zh: 电动20和柴油30是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动20印 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、管径 80 mm、骨料 1–2 cm、距离 120 m / 40 m。柴油30印 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、骨料 3 cm 及以下、距离 60 m / 180 m。两页没有可以共用的管径格。

heading.en: Where Electric 20 and Diesel 30 print different values
heading.zh: 电动20和柴油30哪些数值不同

body.en: Theoretical output: Electric 20 prints 8–10 m³/h; Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 20 prints 10 MPa; Diesel 30 prints 20 MPa. Hopper capacity: Electric 20 prints 0.25 m³; Diesel 30 prints 0.3 m³. Pumping distance (H / V): Electric 20 prints 120 m / 40 m; Diesel 30 prints 60 m / 180 m. Max. aggregate size: Electric 20 prints 1–2 cm; Diesel 30 prints 3 cm and below. Dimensions: Electric 20 prints 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm; Diesel 30 prints 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：电动20印 8–10 m³/h；柴油30印 15 m³/h。最大出口压力：电动20印 10 MPa；柴油30印 20 MPa。料斗容积：电动20印 0.25 m³；柴油30印 0.3 m³。输送距离（水平/垂直）：电动20印 120 m / 40 m；柴油30印 60 m / 180 m。最大骨料粒径：电动20印 1–2 cm；柴油30印 3 cm and below。外形尺寸：电动20印 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm；柴油30印 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 20 prints cells that Diesel 30 does not: Motor power 22 kW; Delivery pipe diameter 80 mm. Diesel 30 prints cells that Electric 20 does not: Diesel engine power 4105 / 56 kW. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动20有、柴油30没有的行：电机功率 22 kW；输送管内径 80 mm。柴油30有、电动20没有的行：柴油机功率 4105 / 56 kW。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: The order inside 120 m / 40 m is not the same pattern as 60 m / 180 m. Read each H / V label on its own page. Open /en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/ for Electric 20 and /en/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 30. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 120 m / 40 m 里的先后，和 60 m / 180 m 不是同一种大小关系。每页的水平/垂直都要单独读。看电动20请打开 /zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/，看柴油30请打开 /zh/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 20 print the same theoretical output as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 电动20和柴油30的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 20 prints 8–10 m³/h. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动20印 8–10 m³/h。柴油30印 15 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 20 print the same max. outlet pressure as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 电动20和柴油30的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 20 prints 10 MPa. Diesel 30 prints 20 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动20印 10 MPa。柴油30印 20 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 20 print the same hopper capacity as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 电动20和柴油30的料斗容积一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 20 prints 0.25 m³. Diesel 30 prints 0.3 m³. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动20印 0.25 m³。柴油30印 0.3 m³。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is motor power missing on Diesel 30?
question.zh: 为什么柴油30没有电机功率？

answer.en: The Diesel 30 page does not print that label. Electric 20 prints 22 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 柴油30这一页没有印这个标题。电动20印的是 22 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
